sources.title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models | AI ...
sources.snippet: This survey organizes video understanding around three core pillars—low-level geometry recovery, high-level semantic reasoning, and unified models that combine both—establishing a conceptual framework for how the field has progressed from task-specific pipelines toward foundation models capable of handling diverse downstream objectives.

sources.title: [2404.03413] MiniGPT4-Video: Advancing Multimodal LLMs for Video ...
sources.snippet: This paper introduces MiniGPT4-Video, a multimodal Large Language Model (LLM) designed specifically for video understanding. The model is capable of processing both temporal visual and textual data, making it adept at understanding the complexities of videos.
